prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion!", "Try feeding, talking, or minimizing your pet right from your desktop workspace.", "Quick Controls: Right-click pet to open settings or hide."]
1: ["Choose Visual Style", "Select how your pet should look rendered on your desktop screen.", "Select Style Preset", "Continue to Photos"]
2: ["Quick Account Link", "Link your account in one click to sync your desktop pet seamlessly.", "Choose Auth Provider", "Automatic sync preserves your pet memory and settings."]
3: ["Welcome to Desktop Pets", "Let us help you find the perfect companion for your desktop workspace.", "What is your workspace style?", "Answer 2 quick questions to get the ideal pet recommended for your workflow.", "Workspace Vibe", "See Recommendation"]
4: ["Use the exact same email or provider to ensure your adopted pets remain linked.", "Account Consistency Tip"]
5: ["Crafting Your Desktop Pet...", "We are generating high-res animations and desktop behaviors.", "Rendering 3D Sprite Sheets", "Estimated 2 minutes remaining"]
6: ["Select Your Adoption Journey", "Browse Journeys"]
7: ["Upload High-Contrast Pet Photos", "Clear single-subject photos work best. Avoid dark lighting or cluttered backgrounds.", "Front-facing poses give your companion the crispest rendering."]
8: ["Shortcut Tip: Ctrl+Shift+P toggles your pet on/off anytime!", "Double click your pet on desktop to open interaction menu."]
9: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Give your new desktop buddy an official name to receive your adoption badge!", "Official Companion Certified", "Companion Name"]
